records.claim: The submission claims a full proof that, for every N >= 1, the maximum size of a set A subset of {1, ..., N} such that ab + 1 is nonsquarefree for every a, b in A is floor((N + 18)/25).

records.claim: The submission claims a proof of the first assertion of Erdős Problem #132 for n = 8: every eight-point planar set has two distinct distances occurring at most eight times.
The unit group L_F2(1,2)× of the binary Leavitt algebra is not sofic.
The manuscript gives a partial result toward Erdős Problem #653, proving an improved upper bound g(n) ≤ n − 1 − cε n^(0.81668−ε).
The paper proves Problem #726 conditionally on an explicitly stated reciprocal-prime equidistribution hypothesis.
